name: Corleck Hill
text: Corleck Hill stands near Drumeague in County Cavan. Its Irish name Sliabh na Tri nDée means the hill of the three gods. Locals once called the place the pulse of Ireland. A stone head of Brigit was worshipped on the hill. Pagan worship met there on the feasts of Imbolc, Beltaine, Lughnasa, and Samain. The three gods of that Irish name are probably Conn, the Dagda, and Ogma. Earlier commentators proposed other triads for the same title.
